lblDorTT: DOR, desired out range (nm): from the closest group, where your out manoeuvre defeats any weapons and leaves room to recommit on the same group.
lblDrTT: DR, decision range (nm): the least range at which you can notch for the briefed time against spikes and still abort outside the threat's weapons envelope.
lblMarTT: MAR, minimum abort range (nm): the range at which you can still turn away, outrun any missiles and stay outside the enemy's weapons envelope (WEZ).
lblFrTT: FR, factor range (nm): the least distance between the group you merge with and the next; groups farther out are unlikely to affect the merge. Set by the weapons on both sides and closure.
lblMtrTT: MTR, minimum targeting range (nm): where the element lead must have targeted or shared a group to be sure of killing it; flight members may target any unassigned group from here.
lblClassTT: Class: the threat fighter type, with its deviation in nm per 10,000 ft from a 25,000 ft base altitude, e.g. MiG-23 (+/-3). One threat a row, yours to fill in.
